description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the AccessTokenRepository component of an OAuth implementation within the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup, multiple test cases for creating, persisting, revoking, and retrieving access tokens, as well as handling edge cases and exceptions.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to verify the correctness and robustness of the AccessTokenRepository in an OAuth context, including token creation, persistence, revocation, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by populating test data and configuring the AccessTokenRepository with an encryption key.

methods.name: testGetNewToken
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new access token with minimal parameters and verifies the token's properties and encrypted string representation.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenWithScopes
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new access token with specific scopes and verifies the scope serialization and client details.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenAndCallGetExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Verifies that calling getExpiryDateTime on an uninitialized token throws an Error.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenAndCallGetIdentifier
methods.description: Verifies that calling getIdentifier on an uninitialized token throws an Error.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Tests persisting a new access token and verifies it is correctly stored with expected properties.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessTokenWithExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to persist a token with a duplicate identifier throws an exception.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that an access token can be revoked and reflects the revoked status in the database.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessTokenWhichAlreadyRevoked
methods.description: Checks that revoking an already revoked token does not change its state.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures silently handling revocation of non-existent tokens without errors.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of revoked status for existing tokens.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevokedForNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that non-existent tokens are reported as not revoked.

methods.name: testGetAccessToken
methods.description: Tests retrieval of existing access tokens by token string and checks behavior for invalid tokens.
